text.arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌۭ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ

words.gloss_range: event-time frame opening the exposure scene; an accusative temporal setting tied to the prior meeting-day warning, not a neutral date
words.root_gloss_range: root range of day, period, event-time, and marked occasion; here the event-day branch frames disclosure and dominion
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) opens the ayah as an accusative event-frame, carrying the prior meeting-day warning into a scene rather than starting a detached report. The root {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) keeps time as a decisive occasion where exposure, non-hiddenness, and dominion become accountable. Its placement before the actors and its contrast with the later definite day make time tighten from frame to verdict-present.

topics.headline: cross-boundary temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah opening inside the already warned meeting-day scene, not as a disconnected new statement.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the word as an accusative temporal noun in apposition to the preceding frame, and the boundary rows make the prior warning grammatically active.

topics.headline: event-time gathers accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the day as the accountable arena where exposure and sovereignty converge, not merely as calendar time.
topics.reason: The y-w-m evidence supports event-time and marked occasion, while the local co-occurrence with exposure and dominion keeps that pressure anchored; the parallel to God-facing emergence (14:48) is illustrative.

topics.headline: time defines actors before they appear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day frames the people before their identity or condition is heard, then returns as the definite verdict-time.
topics.reason: The opening word precedes the pronoun and later contrasts with the definite second day, so sequence and form both support the tightening movement.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person plural pronoun resuming the warned group as the exposed subject
words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) brings the warned group forward as a known subject. Because it is independent, the clause holds them in a nominal state before the exposure predicate defines them. The later suffixal return keeps the same group in view when the no-hiddenness clause turns from exposed persons to what comes from them.

topics.headline: known warned group resumed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the pronoun as carrying forward the warned audience rather than introducing a fresh unnamed class.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence ties the pronoun to the prior meeting-day warning, and the CRITICAL rows press that discourse continuity.

topics.headline: independent subject fixed in exposure state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people defined by a standing exposed condition rather than narrated as agents performing an action.
topics.reason: Local grammar makes the pronoun the subject of a nominal clause whose predicate supplies the defining condition.

topics.headline: same group returns as suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same group from exposed subject to source-domain for every hidden item.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun and the later attached suffix have the same referent but different grammatical roles.

words.gloss_range: standing exposed and manifest as a rational plural group within the day-frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range of emerging, becoming manifest, standing out in open view, and confrontation; here the participial state of exposed visibility is selected
words.prose: {{ar:بَٰرِزُونَ}} ({{tr:bārizūna}}) names a durable exposed state, not just the instant of coming out. The root {{ar:ب ر ز}} ({{tr:b-r-z}}) gives open visibility and manifested standing, while the participle and plural ending make the group a collective condition inside the day-frame. Parallels where parties emerge before God (14:21; 14:48) sharpen the God-facing exposure, and the placement before the hiddenness clause lets visible bodies lead into total inventory.

topics.headline: participial exposed collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people held in a scene-filling exposed condition, not merely reported as having emerged.
topics.reason: The active participle is the predicate of the pronoun, and occurrence notes mark this participial state as a pointed form choice.

topics.headline: open visibility with confrontational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels resurrection here as loss of cover and standing out in open view, while causative or confrontational relatives do not replace the local participial sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports manifestation and open-space visibility; Form III confrontation and causative bringing-out are background pressures, not the selected local form.

topics.headline: exposure precedes no-hiddenness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices visible exposure of persons first, before the ayah widens disclosure to every remaining thing.
topics.reason: The sequence places the exposed predicate before the no-hiddenness clause, and the parallels to emergence before God (14:21; 14:48) fit the local scene.

words.gloss_range: declarative negation of hiddenness with exhaustive scope over the following clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives negation its own visible slot before the hiddenness verb. It denies an ongoing state, not a prohibition, and with the later indefinite item it leaves no hidden residue available. After exposed persons, this negation opens the second movement of disclosure: from bodies in view to things that cannot remain concealed. Its l-sound also threads into the later possession question and answer, so denied hiddenness leads audibly toward assigned ownership.

topics.headline: declarative negation of hiddenness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a declarative denial of possible hiddenness, not a command or limited negation.
topics.reason: The negative particle governs the finite imperfect verb and prepares the indefinite subject for exhaustive force.

topics.headline: negation pivots to hidden inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices visibility expanding from exposed persons to anything from them that might still be concealed.
topics.reason: The negation follows the exposure predicate and opens the clause that ends with the universal item.

topics.headline: sound thread into possession turns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the negation linked into the later possession question and answer by repeated l-sound pressure.
topics.reason: The sound row is local and concrete, and it supports the transition from denied hiddenness to possession language without changing grammar.

words.gloss_range: stative failing-to-be-hidden before God, covering perceptual and cognitive concealment under negation
words.root_gloss_range: root range of hiddenness, obscurity, imperceptibility, and secrecy; here the Form I stative is negated rather than a causative hiding act
words.prose: {{ar:يَخْفَىٰ}} ({{tr:yakhfā}}) is a stative verb whose delayed subject is the thing that fails to remain hidden. The root {{ar:خ ف ي}} ({{tr:kh-f-y}}) reaches obscurity, imperceptibility, and secrecy, so the negation covers what is unseen, unnoticed, or inward. The familiar no-hiddenness formula is focused onto the exposed group (3:5; 14:38), and its same-surah thread prepares the later mention of concealed eyes and breasts (40:19).

topics.headline: stative hiddenness denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause denying the state of being hidden before God, not merely exposing an attempted act of hiding.
topics.reason: The local frame is intransitive or stative with a postponed subject and prepositional relation, while Form I contrasts with causative concealment forms.

topics.headline: obscurity beyond deliberate secrecy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation reaches obscure, imperceptible, and inward matters, not only deliberate secrets.
topics.reason: The kh-f-y field supports sensory and cognitive hiddenness, and local negation makes that range accountable.

topics.headline: cosmic formula localized to exposed group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a broad divine non-hiddenness formula brought down onto these exposed persons and their inventory.
topics.reason: The cited formulas of non-hiddenness (3:5; 14:38) and deeper secrecy (20:7) support the echo, while the local source phrase narrows it to the group.

topics.headline: concealment fails as residue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees public exposure widening into the impossibility of any leftover concealed item.
topics.reason: The verb follows the exposed-state predicate and governs the final universal item; the same root recurs in 40:19 as part of the concealment thread.

words.gloss_range: relational preposition marking the one before whom hiddenness fails, with abstract bearing rather than spatial surface
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) makes hiddenness relational: the issue is the one before whom nothing can be hidden. Its normal overness survives as cognitive bearing and accountability, not as a spatial surface. The phrase is placed before the source group and item, so the divine-facing relation is established before the inventory is named; the pronominal variant tightens that same relation into sharper anaphoric and sound closure rather than changing the canonical explicit naming.

topics.headline: hiddenness measured before God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that concealment is measured before God as a relation of accountability, not treated as simple spatial hiding.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as complement of the hiddenness verb, supporting cognitive and relational force.

topics.headline: pronominal variant compresses relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the accepted variant as sharpening the same divine-facing relation, while the canonical wording still names God explicitly.
topics.reason: The variant evidence changes the complement to a pronoun, but it does not govern the canonical surface or replace the explicit divine name.

topics.headline: divine relation before source and item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets the divine-facing axis before hearing the group-source and universal item.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the source phrase and delayed subject in the local clause.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as the genitive object of the hiddenness relation, anchoring total disclosure before the later dominion answer
words.root_gloss_range: root field of deity, worship, godhood, refuge, and debated overwhelmed turning; here the fixed divine name is the selected referent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the relation of hiddenness before the named God. The root field {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) keeps worship, deity, and ultimate authority in view, while the proper name remains the selected referent. Because God is named here before sovereignty is asked, the later answer repeats the same divine center as both knower and owner.

topics.headline: divine name completes hiddenness relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the unique divine referent fixed as the one before whom nothing from them can hide.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive after the preposition and completes the hiddenness relation before the dominion question opens.

topics.headline: worship and authority field around proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that total knowledge belongs to the worshiped God, while derivational disputes do not alter the local proper-name referent.
topics.reason: The ʾ-l-h field and derivational dispute remain meaningful background, but the local surface is the fixed proper divine name.

topics.headline: knower before owner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names God first as the one before whom nothing hides, then repeats Him as the one to whom dominion belongs.
topics.reason: The local repetition of the divine name joins the hiddenness clause to the possession answer, with non-hiddenness parallels such as 14:38 supporting the first role.

words.gloss_range: source, partitive, or concerning relation tied to the exposed group by an attached plural suffix
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) binds the exhaustive item back to the exposed group. Its range can be from them, among them, or concerning them, so disclosure reaches persons, deeds, facts, affiliations, and record without drifting into abstraction. The attached suffix echoes the earlier independent pronoun while shifting the group from subject to source-domain.

topics.headline: from, among, or concerning them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every hidden item tied to the exposed group as source, part, or concern.
topics.reason: The preposition plus attached suffix qualifies the postponed item and keeps the source relation fused to the group.

topics.headline: same group changes grammatical role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same people from exposed subject into the domain from which every item is disclosed.
topics.reason: The suffix resumes the independent pronoun but changes its syntactic role.

topics.headline: source phrase before item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the accountable group before the universal item arrives.
topics.reason: The source phrase is placed before the final indefinite noun, so the expanding inventory remains tied to them.

words.gloss_range: any referable item, affair, act, or fact from them, made exhaustive by indefiniteness under negation
words.root_gloss_range: root range around thingness, referability, affair, and relation to willing in the wider family; here the broad indefinite noun supplies the universal item
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٌۭ}} ({{tr:shayʾun}}) lands at the end of the negation clause as the delayed subject. As a singular indefinite under negation, it makes disclosure exhaustive item by item. The root {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) keeps the noun broad enough for object, fact, act, matter, or affair, so the ayah moves from exposed persons to every referable residue before turning to total dominion.

topics.headline: delayed indefinite universalizes scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause wait until the end to reveal that not even one unspecified item escapes.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as delayed subject and indefinite under negation, with singular form and tanwīn supporting minimal-unit totality.

topics.headline: broad referable affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not limit the hidden item to physical objects; acts, facts, cases, and affairs are included.
topics.reason: The sh-y-ʾ field supports broad referability, while local grammar makes that breadth exhaustive.

topics.headline: universal item answers into dominion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees micro-inventory and macro-sovereignty connected: no smallest item is hidden before the question of total dominion.
topics.reason: The formula parallels no hidden thing before God (3:5), and the local sequence moves from the final universal item into dominion and subdual.

words.gloss_range: prefixed possession lām opening the question of rightful belonging for dominion
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens the dominion question with possession. It makes the issue rightful belonging and jurisdiction, not merely the identity of someone powerful. Because the answer repeats the same particle, the grammar itself carries the question into its resolution.

topics.headline: question asks rightful belonging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as asking to whom dominion belongs, not who happens to wield power.
topics.reason: The lām is the fronted predicate relation for the nominative dominion noun and retains possession force in the compact question phrase.

topics.headline: same particle links question and answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the answer closing the exact grammatical slot opened by the question.
topics.reason: The question lām returns in the answer lām, linking claimant-space to assignment without needing a connective.

words.gloss_range: interrogative claimant slot governed by the possession lām and immediately closed by the answer
words.prose: {{ar:مَنِ}} ({{tr:mani}}) opens an animate claimant slot inside the possession question. The immediate answer means this is not a request for information but a public enactment of exclusion. For a moment possible holders can be imagined; then the answer closes the field.

topics.headline: interrogative claimant slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a real claimant slot opened by the question form before the answer assigns it.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the lām and remains interrogative inside the compact phrase, while the later answer confirms rhetorical force.

topics.headline: question becomes verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question-shape functioning as public proclamation, not uncertainty.
topics.reason: The immediate answer converts the interrogative form into an enacted assignment of dominion and exclusion of other claimants.

words.gloss_range: definite dominion, sovereignty, jurisdiction, and possession as the known total category at issue
words.root_gloss_range: root range of owning, possessing, ruling, granting possession, and dominion; here the abstract dominion field is selected, not a delegated transfer verb or a ruler noun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُلْكُ}} ({{tr:al-mulku}}) names the known total field of dominion. The root {{ar:م ل ك}} ({{tr:m-l-k}}) spans possession, rule, command, realm, and jurisdiction, but the local abstract noun asks who owns dominion itself, not who receives delegated rule or bears the title king. Divine dominion formulas where ownership and power belong to God stand behind the verdict (3:26; 67:1). Its place before the definite day makes sovereignty the contested object before verdict-time closes the question, and the same dominion-today formula returns later as argument (40:29).

topics.headline: known total dominion as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears dominion as the known total category being publicly assigned, not as a partial kingdom or object of transfer.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and nominative after a fronted predicate, with ellipsis and immediate answer making the question verdict-like.

topics.headline: ownership and rule without delegation takeover
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees possession and rule gathered into one abstract dominion field, while transfer or ruler-noun branches remain outside the selected form.
topics.reason: The root range supports ownership and rule, but local grammar selects the abstract verbal noun for dominion itself rather than Form II or IV transfer or the ruler noun.

topics.headline: divine dominion parallels inform verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this public question to broader divine dominion formulas where ownership and power over every thing belong to God (3:26; 67:1).
topics.reason: The supplied parallels tie dominion to God as owner and holder of power, while the local question voices that reality at exposure.

topics.headline: dominion before verdict-time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disclosure resolve into sovereignty, with the dominion-today formula recurring later as argument (40:29).
topics.reason: The word appears before the temporal adverb in the question, and the same surah repeats the kingdom-today formula at 40:29.

words.gloss_range: the definite verdict-present inside the dominion question, tightening the opening day-frame into now
words.root_gloss_range: root range of day, period, event-time, and marked occasion; here the definite occurrence marks the recognized judgment present
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) makes the question about dominion happen in the verdict-present. The root {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) again marks event-time, but the article turns the earlier day-frame into the recognized now of judgment. By ending the question before the answer, the word lets time itself press toward resolution, echo ownership of the Day of Recompense (1:4), and carry forward into recompense (40:17).

topics.headline: definite verdict-present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears sovereignty being asked in the present of judgment, not as a timeless abstraction detached from the exposure scene.
topics.reason: The word is a definite accusative temporal adverb modifying the dominion question.

topics.headline: definite second day tightens frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first day-frame becoming a definite now inside the question.
topics.reason: The second occurrence has the article and a different function, narrowing the opening temporal frame into answer-time.

topics.headline: time presses answer and recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the dominion question close on verdict-time, echo ownership of the Day of Recompense (1:4), and carry into recompense (40:17).
topics.reason: The word closes the question before the answer, while the supplied y-w-m and m-l-k parallels include 1:4 and the next ayah continues the day sequence.

words.gloss_range: answer lām assigning the previously questioned dominion directly to God
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) begins the answer by placing belonging first. It fills the same possession slot opened by the question and compresses assignment without restating the dominion subject. The mirrored particle makes the reply syntactically exact: the marker that asked ownership now delivers it.

topics.headline: answer assigns dominion by lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears belonging before even the divine name segment, so assignment is the answer’s first fact.
topics.reason: The answer lām supplies the predicate while the dominion subject is understood from the question, making vested possession compact.

topics.headline: mirror and ellipsis make answer exact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same possession particle open and close the claimant-space without argumentative mediation.
topics.reason: The lām in the answer mirrors the lām in the question, and ellipsis suppresses a repeated subject or copula.

words.gloss_range: divine-name segment completing the possessive answer phrase after the lām
words.root_gloss_range: root field of deity, worship, godhood, refuge, and debated overwhelmed turning; here the proper name receives the ownership marker in the answer
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the possessive answer as the divine-name segment after the lām. The root field {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) joins worship and godhood to sovereignty, while the short elliptical phrase makes total assignment feel settled. The second divine-name occurrence answers the first: the one before whom nothing hides is the one to whom dominion belongs. The same-surah movement also reverses resistance to God alone into disclosed dominion for God alone (40:12).

topics.headline: genitive divine name completes answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the answer as a compact possessive fragment whose brevity performs certainty.
topics.reason: The divine-name segment is genitive after the answer lām, and no overt verb is needed for the possession clause.

topics.headline: worshiped name receives ownership marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees dominion assigned to the worshiped God, not to a merely political authority; 3:26 expands the same divine ownership field.
topics.reason: The ʾ-l-h field supplies deity and worship pressure, and the supplied m-l-k parallel at 3:26 supports the divine ownership formula.

topics.headline: same-surah denial reversed into assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse reversal: resistance to God alone (40:12) becomes disclosed dominion for God alone in the answer.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows connect 40:12 with this answer, and the local repetition of the divine name joins knower and owner.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive title naming the possessor as the One and excluding divided sovereignty
words.root_gloss_range: root range of oneness, singleness, uniqueness, aloneness, and divine indivisibility; here the title states exclusive sovereignty rather than commanding unification
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَٰحِدِ}} ({{tr:al-wāḥidi}}) is a genitive appositive title attached to the answer’s possessor. The root {{ar:و ح د}} ({{tr:w-ḥ-d}}) makes oneness evaluative here: divided jurisdiction, coalition, and rival shares are ruled out by the title. As the first final title, it prepares the One-Subduer formula that answers scattered or rival claims (12:39; 13:16), so exclusivity and overpowering explain why no rival dominion survives.

topics.headline: genitive appositive names the possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears oneness as a title of the possessor inside the answer, not a loose afterthought or adverbial alone-form.
topics.reason: The title follows the divine-name phrase in genitive apposition and differs from the adverbial alone form.

topics.headline: number becomes exclusive sovereignty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one-ness become a denial of shared dominion, not a mere counting note.
topics.reason: The w-ḥ-d field supports singularity and divine non-partneredness, while the dominion answer gives it evaluative force.

topics.headline: paired title closes claimant-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the One-Subduer formula as the final answer to scattered or rival claims (12:39; 13:16).
topics.reason: The supplied parallels pair the One with the Subduer, and the local title pair makes the answer both exclusive and irresistible.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive title of irresistible subdual closing the dominion answer
words.root_gloss_range: root range of overcoming, subduing, compelling, and prevailing over resistance; here the intensive title makes subdual characteristic and unilateral
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَهَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-qahhāri}}) closes the ayah as a definite intensive title. The root {{ar:ق ه ر}} ({{tr:q-h-r}}) names overcoming and subduing resistance, and the intensive form makes that force characteristic rather than a single victory. The recurring One-Subduer formula answers rival-source and rival-rule claims (13:16), while earlier dominance-title language is intensified after dominion (6:18). After exposure, non-hiddenness, and the ownership answer, the final word leaves no real contest over dominion, and its doubled consonant gives the close heavier sound after the smoother preceding One-title.

topics.headline: definite intensive title in apposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears subdual as the possessor’s definite, sustained title, not a loose description or reciprocal contest.
topics.reason: The title remains genitive in the appositive chain, and the intensive form strengthens the q-h-r field of overcoming resistance.

topics.headline: One-Subduer formula and form contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final title as part of a recurring exclusive-and-subduing formula, with the intensive form sharpening earlier dominance language (6:18; 13:16).
topics.reason: The supplied parallels include creator and dominion questions, while form contrast with the active-participle dominance title supports intensification without changing the local title.

topics.headline: final word seals resistance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels irresistible subdual as the final landing after claimant-space has closed.
topics.reason: The word is the ayah’s final term, and the sound row ties its heavier close to the meaning of subdual.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَارِزُونَ / لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Emergence from concealment, negated hiddenness, and the unrestricted knowable 'thing' combine into total personal and evidentiary exposure.

activation_trace.role: ظهور الشيء وانكشافه supplies the transition from covered existence to manifest presence and makes it the scene's exposure operator.
الستر والخفاء supplies the concealment explicitly negated, closing every hiding place.
الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه supplies maximal evidentiary scope: anything knowable or reportable about them is included.

changed_reading.before: They are merely visible on a particular day.
changed_reading.after: The day is a total disclosure event in which persons and every knowable or reportable detail of them become jointly manifest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ / لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The question and immediate answer enact, rather than merely describe, the concentration of all rule in the one power able to overcome every rival.

activation_trace.role: كائنة اليوم وشدته supplies an event-day whose severity makes the sovereignty question operative rather than calendrical.
المُلك والسلطان supplies public rule and command as the object whose claimant is tested.
وحدانية الله بلا شريك supplies exclusion of every co-claimant and fixes the answer's singular center.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله supplies the force that makes rival sovereignty claims untenable.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies who reigns at that time.
changed_reading.after: Its question-answer exchange publicly performs the collapse of plural rule into exclusive, irresistible sovereignty.

baseline_models.mechanism: The combat branch of emergence makes exposure a departure from protective ranks: each claimant stands apart before the sole overcoming power, with no collective mainstay left.

activation_trace.role: المبارزة والانفراد للقتال supplies the image of leaving one's group to stand in an unshielded contest.
الانفراد والبينونة supplies separation from companions and converts a mass appearance into deaggregation.
مِلاك الأمر وعِماده supplies the supporting mainstay whose absence or presence the sovereignty question tests.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله supplies the asymmetry that prevents this arena from being a contest among equals.

changed_reading.before: All people appear together before a supreme king.
changed_reading.after: Exposure strips away ranks, patrons, and group cover, leaving each person separately unsupported before the one unequalled overcomer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated twisted disputation tries to make truth lose its footing and proceeds without compelling authority; the focus question then replaces contestable speech with a self-answer backed by sovereign force.

activation_trace.role: المُلك والسلطان anchors the changed reading in the focus question's authority to settle public claims.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله supplies the non-negotiable force behind the final answer.
الخصومة الملتفّة supplies dispute as twisted, self-entangling speech and begins the repeated discourse pattern.
ادعاء الباطل وقول ما لا حقيقة له supplies the unreal claim used as argumentative material.
سقوط الحجة وبطلانها supplies the attempted result: making the opposing proof slip and fall.
ثبات مطابق للواقع ضد الباطل supplies the stable reality that the false dispute cannot dislodge.
السلطان حجة قاهرة defines the compelling proof explicitly absent from the disputants.
رجع وصرف عن وجه supplies the endpoint of the repeated dispute: its speakers are turned away rather than reaching settlement.

structural_cues: 40:4, 40:5, 40:35, 40:56, and 40:69 repeat dispute over the signs; 40:16 instead asks and answers one question without leaving a reply slot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent dispute, attempted destabilization of truth, absent compelling proof, and eventual diversion; I infer that the focus question closes that speech economy. A live alternative is that the question is proclamation rather than the terminal hearing of those disputes.

changed_reading.before: The sovereignty question invites a factual identification of the ruler.
changed_reading.after: The question is a speech-act that ends the surah's proliferating counterclaims: no disputant retains enough authority to keep the answer open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of all-encompassing thinghood with mercy and knowledge places the focus's total exposure inside a field that can disclose in order to know, distinguish, and admit mercy, not only to prosecute.

activation_trace.role: الستر والخفاء anchors the model in the focus's cancellation of concealment.
الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه anchors the repeated total object of knowledge and report.
انفساح الشيء خلاف الضيق supplies an uncontracted field able to contain every case.
الكُلّ إحاطة وتماما supplies exhaustive inclusion rather than a selective sample.
الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه repeats the focus's knowable object under a different governing pair.
الرَّحْمَة والرقة supplies the non-punitive capacity that coextends with the total field.
انكشاف الشيء للعارف supplies disclosure to a knower and directly sharpens the focus's epistemic mechanism.

structural_cues: 40:7 says that mercy and knowledge encompass every thing; 40:16 says that no thing of them is hidden from God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two totalizing constructions around 'thing,' one governed by mercy-and-knowledge and one by non-hiddenness; I infer that they describe one comprehensive field. The live alternative is that 40:16 locally foregrounds judgment so strongly that mercy remains background rather than an active valence.

changed_reading.before: Nothing hidden means exhaustive prosecutorial surveillance.
changed_reading.after: Nothing hidden is exhaustive knowing within a field earlier defined as capacious enough for both mercy and knowledge, so disclosure is not intrinsically identical with condemnation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, 'thing' moves through willing, creating, decisive command, spoken coming-to-be, and the deniers' claim that their partners were no thing; the focus's no-hidden-thing and kingdom question can therefore test who grants and governs determinate thinghood.

activation_trace.role: الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه anchors the model in whatever can stand as a determinate object of knowledge and report.
المِلْك والتصرف anchors the changed reading in effective disposition over things, not title alone.
المشيئة المتعلّقة بالشيء supplies will directed toward bringing about or selecting a thing.
إبداع الخلق وإيجاده supplies origination as the productive side of sovereignty.
الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه makes every determinate thing the scope of that origination.
الحكم والأمر القاطع supplies the decisive transition from possibility to settled outcome.
الطلب والإلزام supplies command as an efficacious directive.
إخراج القول بالنطق supplies the uttered articulation through which the directive is presented.
وقوع الشيء وحضوره في زمان supplies actual occurrence and presence as the command's result.
الشِّرك بالله supplies the rival objects whose effective standing is interrogated.
فقدان الشيء supplies the partners' disappearance from the claimants' accessible field.
الشيء المعلوم المخبر عنه supplies the deniers' evasive reduction of their former objects to 'nothing' they will acknowledge.

structural_cues: 40:15 links will to the warning; 40:62 names God creator of every thing; 40:68 moves from deciding an affair through saying to coming-to-be; 40:73-74 interrogates former partners until the speakers deny having called any thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies will, creation, decisive command, speech, occurrence, and denied partner-objects; I infer a progression in which sovereignty governs what can appear as an effective thing. A live alternative is that 40:74's 'nothing' is only evasive testimony and should not be given ontological force.

changed_reading.before: Every already-existing thing is visible to the sovereign.
changed_reading.after: The focus also asks who has effective disposition over the becoming, knowability, and acknowledged standing of things; rival objects collapse when they cannot answer or act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure supplies evidence; recompense maps each self's acquisition to an outcome; true adjudication, witnesses, and expired excuses turn kingdom into the authority that closes an exact public account.

activation_trace.role: ظهور الشيء وانكشافه anchors the evidentiary stage in the focus's public manifestation.
المُلك والسلطان anchors accounting in the focus's question about final public authority.
كائنة اليوم وشدته repeats the event-day twice and gives the focus's repeated 'day' an immediate accounting content.
مقابلة الفعل بجزائه supplies act-for-outcome correspondence.
طلب الرزق والنفع وإصابته supplies what each self actively acquired and now carries into settlement.
العد والحساب supplies exact enumeration and reckoning.
الحكم والأمر القاطع supplies the contrast between God's conclusive adjudication and the others' inability to decide.
ثبات مطابق للواقع ضد الباطل supplies the reality-conforming standard of judgment.
الحضور مع المشاهدة supplies present witnesses and makes exposure procedurally public.
النفع خلاف الضر supplies efficacy whose negation marks the closure of post-evidence pleading.
العذر والمعذرة supplies the excuse that can no longer alter the settled account.

structural_cues: 40:17 immediately specifies what happens 'today'; 40:20 contrasts God's true judgment with others who decide nothing; 40:51-52 adds witnesses and ineffective excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifestation, recompense, acquired acts, reckoning, adjudication, witnesses, and failed excuse; I infer a single evidentiary procedure linking them. A live alternative is that these are adjacent eschatological features rather than stages of one legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Kingdom means possession of the final scene.
changed_reading.after: Kingdom means exclusive jurisdiction over a public account in which every self, act, witness, and plea is exposed and conclusively matched.

context_deltas.mechanism: A believer's hidden faith is followed by entrusting his affair to the God who sees servants and by protection; concealment is thus a temporary moral tactic visible to God, while the focus abolishes its future necessity rather than treating hiddenness itself as guilt.

activation_trace.role: الستر والخفاء anchors the revised model in the focus's categorical negation of concealment.
إخفاء وستر supplies deliberate concealment as a protective practice rather than proof of inner corruption.
سكون القلب في أمن وثقة identifies the concealed content as trusting faith.
رد الأمر إلى غيرك اتكالا عليه supplies transfer of the hidden believer's affair to divine care.
إبصار العين supplies divine sight of servants despite humanly maintained concealment.
دفع الضرر بوقاية supplies the protection that follows the entrusted affair.

structural_cues: 40:28 introduces a believer concealing faith; 40:44 pairs entrusting his affair with God's sight of servants; 40:45 reports his protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, faith, entrusting, divine sight, and subsequent protection; I infer that protected concealment complicates the moral valence of hiddenness. The live alternative is that protection rewards the believer's whole intervention, not concealment specifically.

changed_reading.before: The removal of hiddenness exposes what was culpably secret.
changed_reading.after: The terminal removal of hiddenness also ends the need for faithful tactical concealment; God had already seen and distinguished such concealment from betrayal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's people are told 'yours is the kingdom today, prevailing in the land'; the focus turns 'yours' into 'whose?/God's' and converts prevailing visibility into exposed visibility before the one overcomer.

activation_trace.role: المُلك والسلطان anchors the reversal in the focus's exact sovereignty noun.
ظهور الشيء وانكشافه anchors the reversal's endpoint: former rulers are now the exposed objects.
وحدانية الله بلا شريك supplies the exclusive answer that replaces the plural possessive claim.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله supplies the final dominance that reverses provisional earthly dominance.
المُلك والسلطان supplies the same public rule first predicated of Pharaoh's people.
وقت النهار المحدود supplies the bounded present in which their kingdom appears to hold.
العلو والغلبة supplies their current prevailing position in the land.
البروز والانكشاف supplies the latent pivot by which being manifest as rulers can become being exposed as subjects.
النصرة عون وإظهار supplies the immediately raised question of whether that human rule can actually protect its holders.
البأس شدة قاهرة supplies the force against which their apparent kingdom already lacks assured defense.

structural_cues: 40:29 has لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ; 40:16 has لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ... لِلَّهِ and describes people as بَٰرِزُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-verbatim 'kingdom today' phrase, the shift from prevailing appearance to exposed appearance, and the question of protection from divine force; I infer a deliberate reversal of the earlier human claim. A live alternative is that the repetition universalizes a conventional sovereignty formula rather than targeting Pharaoh's regime alone.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a universal statement about final divine sovereignty.
changed_reading.after: It also confiscates Pharaoh's own 'kingdom today' formula: those who were visibly dominant become visibly exposed, and 'yours' is reopened as 'whose?' only to be answered 'God's.'

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh controls what his people are shown, then constructs a vertical chain of means to look upon Moses' God; the focus reverses the visual vector, making people exposed while nothing of them escapes God's knowing.

activation_trace.role: ظهور الشيء وانكشافه anchors the observer reversal in the subjects' forced visibility.
الستر والخفاء anchors the reversal in the impossibility of escaping the divine visual-epistemic field.
رؤية العين والبصيرة supplies Pharaoh's joined regime of showing and seeing as the authorized limit of public vision.
السَّبَب حبل ووصلة supplies an imagined connective route upward from the tower.
السَّبَب حبل ووصلة repeats the sought chain of access at the tower's proposed destination.
الإشراف والكشف على الأمر supplies Pharaoh's attempt to obtain elevated inspection and disclosure.

structural_cues: 40:29 limits guidance to what Pharaoh shows and sees; 40:36-37 seeks a tower and celestial means so he may inspect; 40:16 makes human beings the exposed objects before God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled human visual field, an upward inspection project, and terminal human exposure; I supply the directional reversal from would-be observer to observed object. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between limited human sight and unlimited divine knowledge without a deliberate spatial inversion.

changed_reading.before: God sees people whom no concealment can protect.
changed_reading.after: The self-authorized seer who tried to inspect and define the divine horizon is turned into the inspected object; exposure reverses political control of visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Weak followers ask former superiors to cover a share, but the superiors can supply no sufficiency and answer that all are inside the same judgment; the one-overcomer formula therefore flattens delegated power and patronage.

activation_trace.role: الانفراد والبينونة anchors the collapse in the removal of protective association and patronage.
مِلاك الأمر وعِماده anchors the question of what supporting power, if any, still holds the social order up.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله supplies the only asymmetry that remains effective.
خلاف القوة supplies the followers' exposed lack of independent power.
الغَناء والكفاية supplies the relieving sufficiency requested from the former superiors and shown unavailable.
حظ معين مرفوع لصاحبه supplies the particular share they ask the leaders to absorb.
الكُلّ إحاطة وتماما supplies the leaders' admission that the whole hierarchy is enclosed in one condition.
الحكم والقضاء بين الناس supplies the judgment that supersedes the hierarchy's former allocations.

structural_cues: 40:47 preserves the weak/strong social relation only long enough for the weak to request relief; 40:48 has the strong answer that all are in it and God has judged among the servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed delegated relief, a requested share, total inclusion, and divine judgment; I infer that the focus's singular sovereignty is socially deaggregative. A live alternative is that the scene demonstrates only the leaders' incapacity, not the erasure of every human relation.

changed_reading.before: One supreme king rules over an intact ladder of subordinate powers.
changed_reading.after: The sovereignty declaration collapses the ladder itself: patrons cannot carry even a share for dependents, so every rank stands equally exposed beneath the sole effective power.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, seeing overpowering force produces a declaration of faith in God alone, yet that recognition no longer benefits; the focus's visibility and one-overcomer answer therefore mark terminal compelled clarity, not automatically saving acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: ظهور الشيء وانكشافه anchors the model in terminal manifestness.
وحدانية الله بلا شريك anchors the exact content later confessed under visible force.
غلبة من علو تقهر المقهور وتذلله anchors recognition in an asymmetry that can compel submission.
رؤية العين والبصيرة supplies direct sight as the trigger of the closing declaration.
البأس شدة قاهرة supplies the overpowering force made visible.
تصديق يطمئن إليه القلب supplies the claimed belief whose timing is then tested.
وحدانية الله بلا شريك repeats the focus answer as the content of their late confession.
النفع خلاف الضر supplies efficacy explicitly denied to belief after sight.
النقص العام supplies the irreversible deficit remaining after correct but belated acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 40:84 orders sight of force before confession of God alone; 40:85 states that belief did not benefit once the force was seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sight-to-confession sequence and its lack of benefit; I align the seen force with the focus's قَهَّار and the confession with its وَاحِد. A live alternative is that the closing scene is a recurring historical pattern rather than the identical temporal scene of 40:16.

changed_reading.before: Universal disclosure produces universal recognition of the true sovereign.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure produces an unavoidable correct answer, but the answer can be compelled and too late; epistemic clarity and beneficial faith are sharply separated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads anatomy as a spatial mechanism for disclosure, not merely as adjacent fear imagery. It remains anchored in بَارِزُونَ and the focus's negated خفاء, while 40:18-19 places held inner pressure at the throat and names what breasts hide. Downstream prose should present it as a somatic analogy for inner content reaching the boundary, not claim a literal extrusion doctrine.

activation_trace.role: ظهور الشيء وانكشافه anchors the body's hidden content becoming outwardly manifest.
الستر والخفاء anchors the model in the concealment that fails.

changed_reading.before: People stand externally visible while God separately knows their interiors.
changed_reading.after: The scene can be imaged as inner pressure reaching the body's threshold: what was held in the breast becomes part of the person's outward exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the heat-transformation branch of ق ه ر and the cohesion branch of م ل ك rather than their ordinary sovereign senses. It remains focus-anchored and gains a material trigger from 40:72's hot medium and fired filling. Downstream prose should label it strictly as a material analogy for irresistible transformation, never as the lexical definition of ٱلْقَهَّار or a literal physiology.

activation_trace.role: قوة الشيء وتماسكه supplies the cohesion or self-holding that is placed under sovereign pressure.
لحم تأخذه النار فيسيل ماؤه ويتغير supplies a material image of heat forcing latent content out while changing the body.
ذوبان الإهالة والشحم supplies melting as the context's material transformation cue.
إيقاد النار وتهييجها supplies active firing that drives the transformation.

changed_reading.before: The overcomer legally subdues otherwise intact subjects.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, qahr is pressure and heat that break false self-cohesion, force latent content outward, and leave the exposed subject changed.

strongest_changes: 40:29 makes the focus's 'kingdom today' a precise reversal of Pharaoh's provisional 'your kingdom today': visible dominance becomes exposed visibility.
The accounting, judgment, witness, and failed-excuse sequence changes kingdom from possession into exclusive public jurisdiction.
The concealed believer prevents hiddenness from being equated with guilt; terminal disclosure also ends morally protective concealment.
40:84-85 separates correct recognition from beneficial faith: sight of overpowering force can compel the focus's answer only after efficacy has expired.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made visibility politically reversible and morally nonuniform: Pharaoh tries to own what others see, a believer hides faithfully under divine sight, social superiors lose the power to cover dependents, and the final answer becomes both a confiscated royal formula and a compelled confession.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the 40:29 lexical echo targets Pharaoh's regime specifically or primarily universalizes a broader sovereignty formula.
How actively the mercy-and-knowledge envelope of 40:7 should temper the immediate juridical force of 40:16.
The commanded-thinghood and material-pressure readings are coherent but depend on exploratory cross-branch arrows and should remain explicitly contained.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exposure is the collapse of hidden interiority.** `ب ر ز/B001` gives appearing after concealment; `خ ف ي/B001` gives hiddenness. Their explicit negation and juxtaposition create a reveal mechanism. I infer that sovereignty is demonstrated by removing every shelter of secrecy; the day reads as total publication before ownership is declared.
2. **Singularity is enforced from above.** `ق ه ر/B001` gives overpowering from above that subdues. Following the question “whose dominion?” it assigns force to the answer. I infer that rival claims are not merely verbally denied but structurally flattened; unity reads as uncontested rule made manifest by exposure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The former superiors’ leveling admission in 40:48 concretely enacts the flattening of rival sovereignty announced here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Total exposure dissolves partitioned ownership.** Lexically, `ب ر ز:B001` is "appearing and becoming exposed," directly opposed to `خ ف ي:B001`, covering and hiddenness; `م ل ك:B002` is ownership and disposal. Structurally, the meeting announced in 40:15 becomes exposure here, then 40:17 accounts for every self and 40:19 reveals concealed interiors. Exposure's role is to remove the hidden compartments on which separate claims of disposal could rest. The packet gives universal visibility followed by the kingship question; I infer that once no thing remains privately screened, rival ownership cannot be maintained. The question and answer thus emerge causally from disclosure rather than interrupting it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:51-52 reveals that exposure is not only visual: standing witnesses make concealed conduct publicly attestable and dissolve defensive ownership of one's narrative.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bilinen günü güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar süren zaman olarak tanımlar ve onu günler dizisinin tek bir birimi sayar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu iki kurucu özelliği de doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca sınırları gün doğumu ve gün batımıyla belirlenen gündüz süresini kapsar; belirsiz süre, devir ve olay anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanımı tanımlar; günlük işlem bildiren türemiş kullanım, temel gün anlamının yerine geçirilmez.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasındaki sınırı hem de tek bir gün birimi olmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıtlığın geceyle kurulduğu ve sayılabilir birim özelliğinin bağlamdan zaten anlaşıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin doğuşu ile batışı arasındaki aydınlık zaman aralığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hem doğal gündüz sınırının hem de bunun tek bir sayılabilir birim olduğunun açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınırlandırılmış gündüz süresini ve onun tek bir gün birimi oluşunu birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gün gün veya gündelik esasa göre yapılan işlem

Bu çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, gün ile olay arasındaki aktarmaya dayanan bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, büyük veya çetin olayla bağlantılı mecazî ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlarla sınırlıdır; literal zaman süresi ve yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan anma günleri dışarıda kalır.

facets.statement: Gün sözü, büyük bir olay gerçekleştiğinde o kritik zamanı veya gerçekleşen olayı anlatmak üzere aktarılır.
Belirli kalıplarda günün çok çetin, ağır ve etkisi uzun süren bir gün olduğu vurgulanır.
Çoğul biçim, bilinen günlerde gerçekleşmiş önemli olayları veya tarihî vakaları anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gün sözünün büyük bir olayın gerçekleşmesine aktarılmasını, çetin gün anlatımında kullanılmasını ve çoğul biçimin olayları belirtmesini aynı anlamsal aile içinde verir.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın nimet, bağışlama veya cezalandırma gibi unutulmaması gereken etkileriyle anılan günlerdir. Bu bağlama, söz konusu günlerin önemini ve hatırlatıcı değerini yükseltir.

facets.statement: Günler, Tanrı'nın insanlara yönelik etkili ve hatırlanmaya değer işleriyle ilişkilendirilir.

Günlerin Tanrı'ya bağlanması, o günlerde verilen nimetler ve gerçekleşen işler nedeniyle onlara özel değer kazandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, Tanrı'ya bağlanan günlerin nimetleri ve önemli işleri hatırlattığını; bu işlerin bağışlama kadar cezayı da içerebildiğini ve bağlamanın günleri yücelttiğini gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya bağlanmayı, nimet ile cezayı kapsayan hatırlatıcı olayları ve günlerin özel değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam özellikle verilen nimetleri ve bağışlamayı hatırlatıyorsa kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya bağlanan günlerin nimet ve bağışlama yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam geçmiş bir topluluğa inen ceza veya hatırlanması gereken sarsıcı olayı öne çıkarıyorsa uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya bağlanan günlerin ceza ve ibret verici olay yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Anılan olayların gerçekleştiği günler literal zaman birimlerinden oluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği özel bağlama ve hatırlatılan ilahi iştir; komşu dal yalnızca gündüz süresidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı'ya bağlanan, nimet veya ceza olaylarıyla anılan günleri belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir olay veya ilahi bağ kurmadan uzunluğu belirsiz süreyi ya da devri belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gün sözünden hareketle tek bir literal gündüzü aşan zaman anlatımlarına katılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olay ve kutsal bağlama dayalı özel bir ifadedir; komşu dal nötr bir süre veya devir anlamıdır ve anlamsal çekirdekleri örtüşmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أيام الله وما في معناها من أيام النعم والوقائع التي يذكر بها، من عفو أو نعمة أو عذاب نزل بقوم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل جمع أيام، ولا كل يوم شديد، ولا مجرد مدة زمانية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وذكرهم بأيام الله: بما نزل بعاد وثمود وغيرهم من العذاب، وبالعفو عن آخرين (tahdhib)؛ جاءت الأيام بمعنى الوقائع والنعم (tahdhib)؛ أيامه: نعمه (tahdhib)؛ إضافة الأيام إلى الله تشريف لأمرها لما أفاض الله عليهم من نعمه فيها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gün sözünün bağlamda işaret edilen zamanı gösteren bir belirteçle birleştiğini, ortaya çıkan yapının o gün anlamına geldiğini ve yapıya göre çekimli ya da değişmez olabildiğini belirtir. Dal çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel ve gönderimsel yapıyı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bağımsız bir gün anlamı değil, bağlamda daha önce veya sonra belirlenen güne gönderme yapan birleşik yapıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca gün ile bağlama işaret eden belirtecin birleşik yapısına aittir; yalın gün sözüne yeni bir kök anlamı olarak aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gün sözü bağlamda işaret edilen zamana gönderme yapan bir belirteçle birleşir ve o gün veya o sırada anlamını verir. Birleşik yapı, kuruluşuna göre çekimli ya da değişmez biçimde kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Birleşik yapı, hangi gün olduğu bağlamdan belirlenen zamana gönderme yapar.
Yapı, birleşmenin dilbilgisel değerlendirilmesine göre çekimli veya değişmez biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, bağımsız bir kök anlamından çok bağlamca belirlenen güne gönderme yapan birleşik bir zaman gösterimidir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak, gün sözünün işaret belirteciyle birleşmesini ve bu yapının çekimli ya da değişmez kullanılabilmesini birlikte kaydeder.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlamda işaret edilen zamana gönderim işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağlama bağımlı ve dilbilgisel olarak birleşik bir gösterimdir. Komşu dal ise bağlamdan bağımsız temel zaman birimidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağlamın belirlediği tek bir güne veya ana gönderme yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uzunluğu belirsiz herhangi bir zaman dilimini ve bağlama göre bir devri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: işaret edilen gün ile belirsiz süre
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bağlamın zaman yorumunu belirlemesine izin veren gün temelli anlatımlardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın görevi belirli bir zamana işaret etmektir; komşu dal ise zamanın süresini belirsiz bırakır ve gönderim yapısı kurmaz.

branches.what_is_ar: تركيب يوم مع إذ في يومئذ للدلالة على وقت مشار إليه في السياق، مع جواز الإعراب أو البناء بحسب الإضافة.

branches.source_phrase_ar: يركب يوم مع إذ، فيقال: يومئذ؛ وربما يعرب ويبنى، وإذا بني فللإضافة إلى إذ (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin gizlilikten çıkıp görünmesi ile bir şeyi görünür kılmayı aynı anlam çekirdeğinde toplar. Kitap için görünür ya da yayımlanmış olma, bu çekirdeğin sözlüksel olarak sınırlı bir gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel çekirdek görünür olma veya kılmadır; kitapla ilgili yayımlanma yorumu bütün kullanımlara yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın görünme anlamını korurken ettirgen biçimleri ve kitapla sınırlı yayımlanma kullanımını ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gizliyken ortaya çıkıp görünür olması veya üzerindeki örtünün kalkması; ettirgen kullanımlarda bir şeyi ya da kitabı görünür kılmaktır. Kitap nitelemesinde ayrıca yayımlanmış olma anlamı bulunur.

facets.statement: Bir şey kendiliğinden gizlilikten çıkar, belirir ve görünür olur.
Bir kişi bir şeyi görünür duruma getirir, açıkça gösterir veya belirginleştirir.
Kitapla ilgili türemiş kullanımlarda görünür olmanın yanında yayımlanmış olma yorumu da vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görünme, gizlilikten çıkma ve görünür kılma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Kitap nitelemesinde görünür olma açıklamasının yanında bazı aktarımlar yayımlanmış olma yorumunu verir.

concept_gloss.text: görünür hâle gelme veya getirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kendiliğinden belirme çekirdeğini hem de bir şeyi görünür kılan ettirgen uzantıyı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirme, açığa çıkma ve görünür kılma ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gizli ya da örtülü bir şeyin kendiliğinden görünür olduğu cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gizlilikten görünürlüğe geçişi doğal bir eylemle anlatır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir şeyi görünür kıldığı veya belirginleştirdiği ettirgen bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen görünür kılma işlemini ve sonucu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kitap nitelemesindeki yayıma çıkarılmış olma yorumunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kitaba bağlı özel yayımlanma yorumunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak görünme çekirdeğine rağmen odak dalın kitapla sınırlı sözlüksel uzantısı ile komşunun kanaat alanındaki uzantısı birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ettirgen görünür kılmayı ve kitapta yayımlanmış olma yorumunu içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin görünmesi, açılması ve belirginleşmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha çok görünür durumda bulunmayı anlatırken odak dal görünme sürecini, ettirgen göstermeyi ve kitap kullanımını birlikte taşır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ظهور الشيء بعد خفاء، وانكشاف ما كان مستورا، وإظهار الشيء أو الكتاب، والكتاب المبروز بمعنى الظاهر أو المنشور
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه خصوص الفضاء الواسع، ولا المبارزة، ولا التبرز كناية عن قضاء الحاجة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو ظهور الشيء وبدوه؛ برز الشيء فهو بارز؛ أبرزت الشيء أبرزه إبرازا؛ المبروز الظاهر؛ وقال قوم المبروز المنشور (maqayis)؛ برز فلان أي ظهر بعد الخفاء؛ أبرزت الكتاب والشيء أي أظهرته؛ كتاب مبروز مبرز أي منشور (ayn)؛ برزت الشيء تبريزا أي أظهرته وبينته؛ كتاب مبروز أي منشور (sihah)؛ برز أي هو منكشف الشأن ظاهره؛ برز مخفف فمعناه ظهر بعد الخفاء (tahdhib)؛ أن يظهر بذاته؛ أن ينكشف عنه ما كان مستورا منه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, üstü örtülmeyen geniş araziyi ve bir kişinin böyle bir yere çıkmasını açıkça birlikte verir. Çıkma eylemi, yer adının bütün anlamını değil, o yere yönelmeyi anlatan bağımlı kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her tür boşluğu değil, açık ve geniş araziyi ve bu araziye çıkmayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, açık araziyi yalın yer anlamı olarak; oraya çıkmayı ise belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı uzantı olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Çukur, oyuk veya bitki örtüsüyle kapanmamış, uzakta ve genişçe uzanan açık arazidir. Kişi için kullanıldığında böyle bir açık alana çıkmayı veya orada bulunmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Yer, geniş, açık, görünür ve örtüsüz bir arazi parçasıdır.
Bir kişi kapalı yerden çıkarak bu açık araziye gider veya orada bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, geniş ve örtüsüz arazi anlamında ve insanın bu araziye çıkması kullanımında birleşir. Arazi, çukur ya da bitkiyle kapalı bir yerin karşıtı olarak betimlenir.

concept_gloss.text: geniş ve açık arazi
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer adının açık, örtüsüz ve geniş arazi çekirdeğini doğrudan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Arazinin genişliğini, açıklığını ve örtüsüzlüğünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kapalı veya örtülü yerden geniş ve açık araziye yöneldiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin belirli türdeki açık yere çıkışını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: açık araziye çıkmak veya orada bulunmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, arazinin örtüsüz ve görünür olmasını ve kişinin oraya çıkmasını özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, avlu, düzlük ve genel olarak genişleyen yerleri de kapsayan daha geniş bir yer alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da geniş, açık bir yeri ve açık yere çıkma düşüncesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal açık arazinin örtüsüzlüğünü sözlüksel sınır yaparken komşu dal genişlik ve düzlük üzerinden daha çeşitli yerleri içine alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; açık arazi sınırını en iyi belirleyen yakın anlamlı komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البراز للفضاء الواسع المكشوف، وبروز الشخص بمعنى خروجه إلى ذلك الموضع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه التبرز كناية عن قضاء الحاجة إلا من جهة الخروج إلى البراز، ولا البرزخ الحائل بين الشيئين
branches.source_phrase_ar: البراز المتسع من الأرض لأنه باد ليس بغائط ولا دحل ولا هوة (maqayis)؛ البراز المكان الفضاء من الأرض البعيد الواسع؛ تبرز فلان خرج إلى البراز (ayn)؛ برز الرجل يبرز بروزا خرج؛ البراز بالفتح الفضاء الواسع؛ الموضع الذي ليس به خمر من شجر ولا غيره؛ تبرز الرجل أي خرج إلى البراز للحاجة (sihah)؛ البراز المكان الفضاء من الأرض البعيد الواسع؛ خرج الإنسان إلى ذلك الموضع قيل قد برز (tahdhib)؛ البراز الفضاء؛ برز حصل في براز (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sıradan çatışmayı değil, iki rakibin kendi topluluklarından ayrılıp birbirinin karşısına çıkarak teke tek savaşmasını kurucu anlam olarak verir. Dal çerçevesi bu katılımcı değişimini ve karşılıklılığı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalnızca görünmek veya genel savaşa katılmak yetmez; rakiplerin saftan ayrılıp karşılaşması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, savaş adını ve rakiplerin karşılıklı olarak saftan çıkmasını anlatan söz öbeklerini birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: İki rakibin savaşmak üzere kendi saflarından veya topluluklarından ayrılıp birbirinin karşısına çıkması ve teke tek çarpışmasıdır.

facets.statement: Karşılaşma iki rakip arasında, teke tek savaşma amacıyla gerçekleşir.
Her rakip kendi topluluğundan veya safından ayrılarak ötekinin karşısına çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki rakibin karşılıklı biçimde saflarından ayrılıp savaşmak için yüz yüze gelmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir. Genel savaş değil, bire bir karşılaşma vurgulanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki rakibin karşılıklı ve bire bir savaşması öne çıktığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem yarışta öne geçmeyi hem de övgüye değer bir iş veya üstün nitelik sayesinde akranlarını aşmayı verir. Ortak nokta yalnızca görünmek değil, karşılaştırılanlar içinde öne çıkmaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görünür ve açık tavırlı olmayı tek başına bırakmaz; saygınlık, sağlam akıl, güvenilir görüş, temiz karakter ve iffeti birlikte verir. Kadının insanların önüne çıkıp onlarla oturabilmesi bu toplumsal görünürlüğün özel gerçekleşmesidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin görünürlükten ya da bilgiden uzak, saklı durumda kalması veya bir öznenin onu örterek, saklayarak ya da haberini tutarak bu duruma sokmasıdır. Kişinin kendini gözden uzaklaştırması ve bir işi başkalarına duyurmadan yapması bu çekirdeğin uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey görünmez, açığa çıkmamış veya başkalarının bilgisinden uzak durumda kalır.

Kişi bir başkasından gözden uzaklaşarak kendisini görünmez kılar.
Bir karşılaşma ya da iş, herkese açık olmanın karşıtı olarak gizlice gerçekleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, örten nesne ile saklı kalan şey ortaklığının yanında kanadın iç tüyleri, hurmanın iç yaprakları, görünmeyen varlıklar, kuyu ve koruluk gibi sözlüksel olarak yerleşmiş referansları da aynı dalda toplar. Hazırlanmış çerçeve kullanılabilir; ancak bu referansların tek bir nesne türü değil, örtme veya saklılık bağıyla adlandırılmış ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmeler olduğu açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ad ve referans ağırlıklıdır; gizleme eyleminin kendisi, saklılığı giderme işlemi ve zayıf şimşek parlaması bu nominal kapsamın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak örten veya saklı kalan şey çekirdeği, yalnız belirli biçimlerde yaşayan tüy, yaprak, kuyu, koruluk, görünmeyen varlık ve kalıplaşmış betimlemelerden ayrılır; bu özel adlandırmalar yalın anlamın tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüşten saklayan örtü veya kendisi görünmeyen, içeride kalan ya da gizli sayılan şey için kullanılan adlandırmadır. Kanadın iç tüyleri, hurmanın göbeğe yakın yaprakları, görünmeyen varlıklar, kuyu ve koruluk gibi referanslar bu çekirdeğe bağlı sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalardır.

facets.statement: Bir nesne başka bir şeyi örter veya kendisi saklı ve görünmez durumda bulunur.
Kanadın ön tüylerinin gerisinde kalan iç tüyler ile hurmanın göbeğine yakın yapraklar saklı konumları üzerinden adlandırılır.
Görünmeyen bir varlık veya bedende gizlendiğine inanılan böyle bir varlık, saklılık niteliğiyle adlandırılır.
Kuyu, sık ağaçlık ve saklı yer gibi çevresinden gizlenen mekânlar bu adlandırmanın sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
Bazı yerleşmiş kullanımlar belirli aslan yataklarını veya bir kadının sesiyle yerde bıraktığı izi birlikte adlandıran özel sözlüksel değerler taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak anlatımı, örten nesne ve saklı kalan referans çekirdeğini çok sayıda yerleşmiş ada dağıtır. Kanadın iç tüyleri birden çok aktarımda birleşirken hurma yaprakları, örtü ve giysi, görünmeyen varlık, kuyu, koruluk ve başka özel adlandırmalar dalın kapsamını örnekler; bunlar tek bir fiziksel nesne sınıfına indirgenemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sık ağaçlığı yalnızca saklı mekân referanslarından biri olarak içerir ve başka birçok örtü ya da gizli şey adını da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal saklılık üzerinden kuyu ve koruluk gibi mekânları, ayrıca örtü ve görünmeyen varlıkları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kap, barınak, hücre ve in gibi içine alan ya da sığınak olan yapıları adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kuyu, korunak ve hayvan yatağı gibi çevreleyen mekânlar iki dalı aynı somut alana getirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta mekânın gizli kalması, komşuda ise içine alma, barındırma veya kap olma işlevi esastır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Gizleme eylemi, genel örtme, ayırıcı perde, sık ağaçlık ve kap ya da barınak adayları dalın başlıca sınırlarını gösterdi; geniş giysi ve kumaş parçası adayları yalnız örtünün dar örnekleriydi, diğer genel örtme adayları yayımlanan karşılaştırmaları yineledi, saklılığı giderme kardeş dalı ters işlemi anlattı ve zayıf şimşek dalıyla anlamlı bir ortak çekirdek bulunmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخفاء بمعنى الغطاء أو الرداء، والخوافي من الجناح والسعف، والخافي للجن، والموضع الخافي، والخفية للبئر أو الغيضة أو العرين
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه فعل الكتمان نفسه إذا كان المقصود مجرد الإخفاء، ولا الإخراج من الخفاء
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخوافي سعفات يلين قلب النخلة والخافي الجن (maqayis); الخفا مقصور الشيء الخافي والموضع الخافي والخفاء رداء تلبسه المرأة وكل شيء غطيت به شيئا فهو خفاء والخفية غيضة والخفية بئر والخوافي من الجناحين (ayn); الخافي الجن والخافية ما يخفى في البدن من الجن والخفية الركية والخوافى ما دون الريشات العشر والخوافي من السعف (sihah); الخفاء ما يستر به كالغطاء والخوافي جمع خافية وهي ما دون القوادم من الريش (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi bu dalı açıkça gizlemenin karşı yönü olarak kurar: saklı bir şeyin gizliliği giderilir, görünür kılınır veya bulunduğu yerden çıkarılır. Yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarması ve gizli şeyi çıkarma kullanımları, ortaya çıkarma çekirdeğinin somut gerçekleşmeleridir; hazırlanmış çerçeve bu katılımcı ve sonuç ilişkisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca önceden saklı olanın gizliliğinin giderilmesini veya gizli yerinden çıkarılmasını kapsar; genel görünme, her türlü çıkarma ve şimşeğin belirmesi tek başına yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gizliliği giderip ortaya çıkarma çekirdeği ile sırrın belli olmasını, yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarmasını ve gizli şeyi çekip almayı anlatan biçim ve söz öbekleri ayrılır; bu özel koşullar yalın çekirdeğe genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Önceden saklı veya görünmez olan bir şeyin üzerindeki gizliliği gidererek onu görünür kılmak ya da bulunduğu gizli yerden dışarı çıkarmaktır. Açıklığa kavuşan sır ve yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarması bu yön değişiminin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir özne saklı bir şeyin gizliliğini giderir ve onu görünür veya bilinir duruma getirir.
Gizli yerde bulunan bir şey dışarı alınarak ortaya çıkarılır.
Yağmur, fareleri veya benzeri hayvanları yuvalarından dışarı çıkarır.
Gizli tutulan bir sır veya iş açıklığa kavuşup belli olur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, saklılığı kaldırma ile gizli yerde bulunan şeyi dışarı çıkarma işlemlerini aynı ortaya çıkarma yönünde birleştirir. Geçişli gösterme, gizli nesneyi çıkarma ve yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarması bu yönün farklı katılımcı düzenleridir; bazı biçimler aynı kökün gizleme anlamına karşıt değer taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خفيت الشيء بمعنى أظهرته أو أزلت خفاءه، وخفا المطر الفأر أو الجرذان إذا أخرجها، والاستخفاء بمعنى استخراج الشيء

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأصل الآخر الإظهار وخفيت الشيء بغير ألف إذا أظهرته وخفا المطر الفأر من حجرتهن أخرجهن (maqayis); الخفا إخراجك الشيء الخفي وإظهاركه وخفيت الخرزة من تحت التراب أخفيها خفيا (ayn); وخفيته أيضا أظهرته وهو من الأضداد وخفى المطر الفأر إذا أخرجهن واستخفيت الشئ أي استخرجته وأخفيها أي أزيل عنها خفاءها (sihah); وخفيته أزلت خفاه وذلك إذا أظهرته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, şimşeğin buluttan beliren zayıf, belli belirsiz veya düşük şiddetli parlamasını tutarlı biçimde bildirir. Hazırlanmış dal bu olayın katılımcısını, görünür olma evresini ve ayırt edici güç düşüklüğünü korur; genel ortaya çıkarma anlamıyla birleştirilmesini gerektiren bir kanıt yoktur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız şimşeğin bulut içinde veya buluttan zayıfça parlamasıdır; her parlama, sürekli şimşek, genel görünme ve gizli bir nesneyi ortaya çıkarma bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın şimşeğe bağlı zayıf parlama anlamıyla sınırlıdır; komşu parıltı türleri, genel görünme ve başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Şimşeğin bulutun içinden veya kenarlarında düşük şiddetle, belli belirsiz biçimde parlayıp görünmesidir. Ayırt edici unsur yalnız parlaması değil, parlamanın zayıf ve saklıya yakın oluşudur.

facets.statement: Şimşek düşük şiddetli ve belli belirsiz bir ışıkla parlar.
Zayıf ışık bulutun içinden belirir veya bulutun çeşitli kenarlarında yatay biçimde görünür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar şimşeğin zayıf ve belli belirsiz parlamasında birleşir. Bazı anlatımlar düşük şiddeti doğrudan vurgularken bazıları ışığın buluttan belirmesini veya bulutun çevresinde yayılışını açıklar; bunlar aynı sınırlı parıltı olayının tamamlayıcı yönleridir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: خفا البرق خفوا إذا لمع ويكون ذلك في أدنى ضعف (maqayis); وخفا البرق يخفو خفوا ويخفى خفيا أي ظهر من الغيم (ayn); خفا البرق يخفو خفوا وخفوا إذا لمع لمعانا خفيا (jamhara); وخفا البرق يخفو خفوا ويخفى خفيا إذا لمع لمعا ضعيفا معترضا في نواحى الغيم (sihah)

root_profile.summary: Kök, gizli kalma ve gizleme çekirdeği çevresinde bu niteliği taşıyan nesne ve referansları, aynı durumun karşı yönü olan açığa çıkarmayı ve ayrı bir dal olarak şimşeğin zayıf parlamasını örgütler. İlk üç dal gizlilik ekseninde durum, ad ve yön değişimini paylaşırken son dal belli belirsiz görünme niteliğiyle sınırlı bir doğa olayını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.
